description:
Registered conventions: the headers listings fill in. Each extends the trunk (name, description, need, can,
        contact) with 5-9 dimensions of a field of work, e.g. local-services (service, location, rate...). With a
        query (e.g. 'dog walking'), the closest come first. Pick one before post_listing. Also public at
        GET /conventions.
name: list_conventions
